epics.title: Epic A - Platform foundation
epics.body:
## Summary
Establish baseline repository workflows, quality gates, and release hygiene.

## Goals
- Standardize contributor workflow
- Ensure CI checks run reliably
- Provide clear release and rollback paths

## Definition of Done
- Core CI and linting checks are stable
- Branch/rules defaults are documented
- Team can ship a tagged release end-to-end

tickets.title: A1: Add CI pipeline
tickets.body:
## Summary
Implement baseline CI for formatting, linting, and tests.

## Scope
- Add CI workflow file
- Run tests for enabled languages
- Document local parity commands in README

## Acceptance Criteria
- CI runs on push and pull request
- Failing checks block merge by policy
- README includes local test/lint commands

tickets.title: A2: Document release checklist
tickets.body:
## Summary
Create a lightweight release checklist for maintainers.

## Scope
- Define versioning and tagging steps
- Add smoke-test steps before release
- Add rollback and hotfix guidance

## Acceptance Criteria
- Checklist exists in repo docs
- Tag-and-release flow is reproducible by a new maintainer
